# Anastasia Tulentseva

> Anastasia Tulentseva is a senior software engineer and CTO. She is CTO and co-founder of Anato, a food startup that analyses bread crumb structure for the baking industry.

Her work spans full-stack system architecture, engineering management, and technical strategy.

Also known as: Anastasiia Tulentseva
